ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms external contracts, failure cases and the production-account flag are declared; it does not call the service.
offer: Check the external contract with isolated test credentials and explicit failure cases. Integration validation must not require a production account or alter real customer data.

mid.reason: List the failure cases exercised, such as timeout and error responses. A happy-path-only check misses outages, so add them.
